name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v543: Cloudflare actually solves in WebView. (1) Both visible and headless WebViews now use the SAME cleaned User-Agent (cleanUserAgent helper). The raw WebView UA was fingerprinted by Cloudflare as suspicious and never got cf_clearance issued. (2) Restored WebView settings Cloudflare's Turnstile challenge needs: setSupportMultipleWindows(true), javaScriptCanOpenWindowsAutomatically=true, mixedContentMode=ALWAYS_ALLOW, allowContentAccess=true, allowFileAccess=true, loadsImagesAutomatically=true. Without these the challenge never renders and cf_clearance is never issued — which is why no Cloudflare box appeared and no cookies were saved. (3) Invisible mode still never falls back to visible popup (v542). (4) kwik.cx remains in bypass list (v541). (5) 15-second solve cooldown, 30-second poll timeout, always require cf_clearance, clear in-flight bypass on dismiss, background API config load, removed double-poll.
